nodes.name: Appearance
nodes.summary: Appearance specifies the visual properties of geometry by containing the Material, ImageTexture/MovieTexture/PixelTexture, FillProperties, LineProperties, programmable shader nodes (ComposedShader, PackagedShader, ProgramShader) and TextureTransform nodes.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: Optional single contained Material, PhysicalMaterial, TwoSidedMaterial (deprecated), or UnlitMaterial node that can specify visual attributes for lighting response (color types, transparency, etc.

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: Optional single contained texture node (ImageTexture, MovieTexture, PixelTexture, MultiTexture) that maps image(s) to surface geometry.

fields.name: textureTransform

fields.name: lineProperties

fields.name: pointProperties
fields.doc: Optional single contained PointProperties node that can specify additional visual attributes applied to corresponding point geometry.

fields.name: fillProperties
fields.doc: Optional single contained FillProperties node that can specify additional visual attributes applied to polygonal areas of corresponding geometry, on top of whatever other appearance is already defined.

fields.name: acousticProperties

fields.name: alphaCutoff

fields.name: backMaterial

fields.name: shaders

nodes.name: AudioClip

nodes.summary: CylinderSensor converts pointer motion (for example, a mouse or wand) into rotation values using an invisible cylinder aligned with local Y-axis.

fields.doc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of this node.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enables/disables node operation.

fields.name: maxAngle
fields.doc: clamps rotation_changed events within range of min/max values Hint: if minAngle > maxAngle, rotation is not clamped.

fields.name: minAngle
fields.doc: clamps rotation_changed events within range of min/max values Hint: if minAngle > maxAngle, rotation is not clamped.

fields.doc: When resumeTime becomes <= time now, isPaused becomes false and MovieTexture becomes active.

fields.doc: Current elapsed time since MovieTexture activated/running, cumulative in seconds, and not counting any paused time.

fields.name: repeatS
fields.doc: Whether to repeat texture along S axis horizontally from left to right.

fields.name: repeatT
fields.doc: Whether to repeat texture along T axis vertically from top to bottom.

fields.name: url
fields.doc: Location and filename of movie file or stream.

fields.name: textureProperties
fields.doc: Optional single contained TextureProperties node that can specify additional visual attributes applied to corresponding texture images.

nodes.name: NavigationInfo
nodes.summary: NavigationInfo describes the user's viewing model, user navigation-interaction modalities, and also dimensional characteristics of the user's (typically invisible) avatar.

fields.name: avatarSize
fields.doc: avatarSize triplet values define three separate parameters: (a) collisionDistance between user and geometry, i.

fields.name: headlight
fields.doc: Enable/disable directional light that always points in the direction the user is looking.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Default rate at which viewer travels through scene, meters/second.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Enter one or more quoted SFString values: "EXAMINE" "WALK" "FLY" "LOOKAT" "EXPLORE" "ANY" "NONE".

fields.name: visibilityLimit
fields.doc: Geometry beyond the visibilityLimit may not be rendered (far clipping plane of the view frustrum).

fields.name: transitionType
fields.doc: Camera transition between viewpoints.

fields.name: transitionTime
fields.doc: transitionTime defines the expected duration of viewpoint transition in seconds.

fields.name: set_bind
fields.doc: Receiving event set_bind=true activates and binds this node at the top of the binding stack.

fields.name: bindTime
fields.doc: Event sent reporting timestamp when node becomes active/inactive.

fields.name: isBound
fields.doc: Output event true gets sent when node becomes bound and activated, otherwise output event false gets sent when node becomes unbound and deactivated.

nodes.name: Normal
nodes.summary: Normal defines a set of 3D surface-normal vectors that apply either to a sibling Coordinate | CoordinateDouble node, or else to a parent ElevationGrid node.

fields.name: vector
fields.doc: set of unit-length normal vectors, corresponding to indexed polygons or vertices.

nodes.name: NormalInterpolator
nodes.summary: NormalInterpolator generates a series of normal (perpendicular) 3-tuple SFVec3f values.

fields.name: set_fraction
fields.doc: set_fraction selects input key for corresponding keyValue output.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: Definition values for linear-interpolation function input intervals, listed in non-decreasing order and corresponding to a value in the keyValue array.

fields.name: keyValue
fields.doc: Output values for linear interpolation, each corresponding to an input-fraction value in the key array.

fields.name: value_changed
fields.doc: Linearly interpolated output value determined by current key time and corresponding keyValue pair.

nodes.name: OrientationInterpolator
nodes.summary: OrientationInterpolator generates a series of 4-tuple axis-angle SFRotation values.

fields.name: set_fraction
fields.doc: set_fraction selects input key for corresponding keyValue output.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: Definition values for linear-interpolation function input intervals, listed in non-decreasing order and corresponding to a value in the keyValue array.

fields.name: keyValue
fields.doc: Output values for linear interpolation, each corresponding to an input-fraction value in the key array.

fields.name: value_changed

nodes.name: PixelTexture
nodes.summary: PixelTexture creates a 2D-image texture map using a numeric array of pixel values.

fields.name: repeatS
fields.doc: Whether to repeat texture along S axis horizontally from left to right.

fields.name: repeatT
fields.doc: Whether to repeat texture along T axis vertically from top to bottom.

fields.name: image
fields.doc: Defines image: width, height, number_of_components per each pixel value, and list of pixel_values.

fields.name: textureProperties
fields.doc: Optional single contained TextureProperties node that can specify additional visual attributes applied to corresponding texture images.

nodes.name: PlaneSensor
nodes.summary: PlaneSensor converts pointing device motion into 2D translation parallel to the local Z=0 plane.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enables/disables node operation.

fields.name: autoOffset
fields.doc: Determines whether previous offset values are remembered/accumulated.

fields.name: trackPoint_changed
fields.doc: trackPoint_changed events give intersection point of bearing with sensor's virtual geometry.

fields.name: isActive
fields.doc: Select geometry by activating the pointing device (for example, clicking the mouse) to generate isActive events.

fields.name: isOver
fields.doc: Hover over geometry by aiming the mouse (or pointing device) to generate isOver events.

fields.name: translation_changed
fields.doc: translation_changed events equal sum of relative translation change plus offset value.

fields.name: minPosition
fields.doc: minPosition and maxPosition clamp translations to a range of values measured from origin of Z=0 plane default maxPosition < minPosition means no clamping.

fields.name: maxPosition
fields.doc: minPosition and maxPosition clamp translations to a range of values measured from origin of Z=0 plane default maxPosition < minPosition means no clamping.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Sends event and remembers last value sensed.

fields.name: axisRotation
fields.doc: axisRotation determines local sensor coordinate system by rotating the local coordinate system.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of this node.

nodes.name: PointLight
nodes.summary: Linear attenuation may occur at level 2, full support at level 3.

fields.name: ambientIntensity
fields.doc: Brightness of ambient (nondirectional background) emission from the light.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: color of light, applied to colors of objects.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Brightness of direct emission from the light.

fields.name: on
fields.doc: Enables/disables this light source.

fields.name: global
fields.doc: Global lights illuminate all objects within their volume of lighting influence.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position of light relative to local coordinate system.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Maximum effective distance of light relative to local light position, affected by ancestor scaling.

fields.name: attenuation
fields.doc: Constant, linear-distance and squared-distance dropoff factors as radial distance increases from the source.

nodes.name: PointSet
nodes.summary: PointSet is a node that contains a set of colored 3D points, represented by contained Color|ColorRGBA and Coordinate|CoordinateDouble nodes.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Optional single contained Color or ColorRGBA node that can specify color values applied to corresponding vertices according to colorIndex and colorPerVertex fields.

fields.name: coord
fields.doc: Optional single contained Coordinate or CoordinateDouble node that can specify a list of vertex values.

nodes.name: PositionInterpolator
nodes.summary: PositionInterpolator generates a series of 3-tuple SFVec3f values.

fields.name: set_fraction
fields.doc: set_fraction selects input key for corresponding keyValue output.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: Definition values for linear-interpolation function input intervals, listed in non-decreasing order and corresponding to a value in the keyValue array.

fields.name: keyValue

fields.name: value_changed

nodes.name: ProximitySensor
nodes.summary: ProximitySensor generates events when the viewer enters, exits and moves within a region of space (defined by a box).

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Position offset from origin of local coordinate system.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: size of Proximity box around center location, oriented within local transformation frame.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enables/disables node operation.

fields.name: isActive
fields.doc: isActive true/false events are sent as viewer enters/exits Proximity box.

fields.name: position_changed
fields.doc: Sends translation event relative to center.

fields.name: orientation_changed
fields.doc: Sends rotation event relative to center.

fields.name: centerOfRotation_changed
fields.doc: Sends changed centerOfRotation values, likely caused by user interaction.

fields.name: enterTime
fields.doc: Time event generated when user's camera enters the box.

fields.name: exitTime
fields.doc: Time event generated when user's camera exits the box.

nodes.name: ScalarInterpolator
nodes.summary: ScalarInterpolator generates piecewise-linear SFFloat values.

fields.name: set_fraction

fields.doc: Definition values for linear-interpolation function input intervals, listed in non-decreasing order and corresponding to a value in the keyValue array.

fields.doc: Output values for linear interpolation, each corresponding to an input-fraction value in the key array.

fields.name: value_changed
fields.doc: Linearly interpolated output value determined by current key time and corresponding keyValue pair.

nodes.name: Script
nodes.summary: Script contains author-programmed event behaviors for a scene.

fields.name: url
fields.doc: List of address links for runnable script files.

fields.name: mustEvaluate
fields.doc: If mustEvaluate false, then the X3D player may delay sending input events to Script until output events are needed.

fields.name: directOutput
fields.doc: Set directOutput true if Script has field reference(s) of type SFNode/MFNode, and also uses direct access to modify attributes of a referenced node in the Scene.

nodes.name: Shape
nodes.summary: Shape can appear under any grouping node.

fields.name: appearance
fields.doc: Optional single contained Appearance node that can specify visual attributes (such as material, texture, fillProperties and lineProperties) applied to corresponding geometry.

fields.name: geometry
fields.doc: Optional single contained geometry node that is rendered according to corresponding appearance.

fields.name: bboxCenter
fields.doc: Bounding box center accompanies bboxSize and provides an optional hint for bounding box position offset from origin of local coordinate system.

fields.name: bboxSize
fields.doc: Bounding box size is usually omitted, and can easily be calculated automatically by an X3D player at scene-loading time with minimal computational cost.

fields.name: bboxDisplay
fields.doc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: Whether or not renderable content within this node is visually displayed.

fields.name: castShadow
fields.doc: castShadow defines whether this Shape casts shadows as produced by lighting nodes.

nodes.name: Sound
nodes.summary: The Sound node controls the 3D spatialization of sound playback by a child AudioClip or MovieTexture node.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: direction of sound axis, relative to local coordinate system.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Factor [0,1] adjusting loudness (decibels) of emitted sound.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position of sound ellipsoid center, relative to local coordinate system.

fields.name: maxBack
fields.doc: Outer (zero loudness)ellipsoid distance along back direction.

fields.name: minBack
fields.doc: Inner (full loudness) ellipsoid distance along back direction.

fields.name: maxFront
fields.doc: Outer (zero loudness)ellipsoid distance along front direction.

fields.name: minFront
fields.doc: Inner (full loudness) ellipsoid distance along front direction.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Player hint [0,1] if needed to choose which sounds to play.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: sound source for the Sound node, either an AudioClip node or a MovieTexture node.

fields.name: spatialize
fields.doc: Whether to spatialize sound playback relative to viewer.

nodes.name: Sphere
nodes.summary: Sphere is a geometry node, representing a perfectly round geometrical object that is the surface of a completely round ball.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Size in meters.

fields.name: solid
fields.doc: Setting solid true means draw only one side of polygons (backface culling on), setting solid false means draw both sides of polygons (backface culling off).

nodes.name: SphereSensor
nodes.summary: SphereSensor converts pointing device motion into a spherical rotation about the origin of the local coordinate system.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enables/disables node operation.

fields.name: autoOffset
fields.doc: Determines whether previous offset values are remembered/accumulated.

fields.name: trackPoint_changed
fields.doc: trackPoint_changed events give intersection point of bearing with sensor's virtual geometry.

fields.name: isActive
fields.doc: Select geometry by activating the pointing device (for example, clicking the mouse) to generate isActive events.

fields.name: isOver
fields.doc: Hover over geometry by aiming the mouse (or pointing device) to generate isOver events.

fields.name: rotation_changed
fields.doc: rotation_changed events equal sum of relative bearing changes plus offset value.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Sends event and remembers last value sensed.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of this node.

nodes.name: SpotLight
nodes.summary: Linear attenuation may occur at level 2, full support at level 3.

fields.name: ambientIntensity
fields.doc: Brightness of ambient (nondirectional background) emission from the light.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: color of light, applied to colors of objects.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Brightness of direct emission from the light.

fields.name: on
fields.doc: Enables/disables this light source.

fields.name: global
fields.doc: Global lights illuminate all objects within their volume of lighting influence.

fields.name: attenuation
fields.doc: Constant, linear-distance and squared-distance dropoff factors as radial distance increases from the source.

fields.name: beamWidth
fields.doc: Inner conical solid angle (in radians) where light source has uniform full intensity.

fields.name: cutOffAngle
fields.doc: Outer conical solid angle (in radians) where light source intensity becomes zero.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Orientation vector of light relative to local coordinate system.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position of light relative to local coordinate system.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Maximum effective distance of light relative to local light position, affected by ancestor scaling.

nodes.name: Switch
nodes.summary: Switch is a Grouping node that only renders one (or zero) child at a time.

fields.name: children
fields.doc: Grouping nodes contain an ordered list of children nodes.

fields.name: bboxCenter
fields.doc: Bounding box center accompanies bboxSize and provides an optional hint for bounding box position offset from origin of local coordinate system.

fields.name: bboxSize
fields.doc: Bounding box size is usually omitted, and can easily be calculated automatically by an X3D player at scene-loading time with minimal computational cost.

fields.name: bboxDisplay
fields.doc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

fields.name: whichChoice
fields.doc: Index of active child choice, counting from 0.

nodes.name: Text
nodes.summary: Text is a 2D (flat) geometry node that can contain multiple lines of string values.

fields.name: string
fields.doc: Single or multiple string values to present as Text.

fields.name: fontStyle
fields.doc: The fontStyle field can contain a FontStyle or ScreenFontStyle node defining size, family, and style for presented text.

fields.name: length
fields.doc: Array of length values for each text string in the local coordinate system.

fields.name: maxExtent
fields.doc: Limits/compresses all text strings if max string length is longer than maxExtent, as measured in local coordinate system.

fields.name: solid
fields.doc: Setting solid true means draw only one side of polygons (backface culling on), setting solid false means draw both sides of polygons (backface culling off).

nodes.name: TextureCoordinate
nodes.summary: TextureCoordinate specifies 2D (s,t) texture-coordinate points, used by vertex-based geometry nodes (such as IndexedFaceSet or ElevationGrid) to map textures to vertices (and patches to NURBS surfaces).

fields.name: point
fields.doc: pairs of 2D (s,t) texture coordinates, either in range [0,1] or higher if repeating.

nodes.name: TextureTransform
nodes.summary: TextureTransform shifts 2D texture coordinates for positioning, orienting and scaling image textures on geometry.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: center point in 2D (s,t) texture coordinates for rotation and scaling.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Single rotation angle of texture about center (opposite effect appears on geometry).

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Non-uniform planar scaling of texture about center (opposite effect appears on geometry).

fields.name: translation
fields.doc: Lateral/vertical shift in 2D (s,t) texture coordinates (opposite effect appears on geometry).

nodes.name: TimeSensor
nodes.summary: TimeSensor continuously generates events as time passes.

fields.name: loop
fields.doc: Repeat indefinitely when loop=true, repeat only once when loop=false.

fields.name: startTime
fields.doc: When time now >= startTime, isActive becomes true and TimeSensor becomes active.

fields.name: stopTime
fields.doc: When stopTime becomes <= time now, isActive becomes false and TimeSensor becomes inactive.

fields.name: pauseTime
fields.doc: When time now >= pauseTime, isPaused becomes true and TimeSensor becomes paused.

fields.name: elapsedTime
fields.doc: Current elapsed time since TimeSensor activated/running, cumulative in seconds, and not counting any paused time.

fields.name: resumeTime
fields.doc: When resumeTime becomes <= time now, isPaused becomes false and TimeSensor becomes inactive.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Time continuously sends the absolute time (value 0.

fields.name: cycleTime
fields.doc: cycleTime sends a time outputOnly at startTime, and also at the beginning of each new cycle (useful for synchronization with other time-based objects).

fields.name: cycleInterval
fields.doc: cycleInterval is loop duration in seconds.

fields.name: isActive
fields.doc: isActive true/false events are sent when TimeSensor starts/stops running.

fields.name: isPaused
fields.doc: isPaused true/false events are sent when TimeSensor is paused/resumed.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enables/disables node operation.

fields.name: fraction_changed
fields.doc: fraction_changed continuously sends value in range [0,1] showing time progress in the current cycle.

nodes.name: TouchSensor
nodes.summary: TouchSensor tracks location and state of the pointing device, detecting when a user points at or selects (activates) geometry.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enables/disables node operation.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Author-provided prose that describes intended purpose of this node.

fields.name: hitNormal_changed
fields.doc: When pointing device selects geometry, send event containing surface normal vector at the hitPoint.

fields.name: hitPoint_changed
fields.doc: When pointing device selects geometry, send event containing 3D point on surface of underlying geometry, as measured in reference frame for TouchSensor's local coordinate system.

fields.name: hitTexCoord_changed
fields.doc: When pointing device selects geometry, send event containing texture coordinates of surface at the hitPoint.

fields.name: isActive
fields.doc: Select geometry by activating the pointing device (for example, clicking the mouse) to generate isActive events.

fields.name: isOver
fields.doc: Hover over geometry by aiming the mouse (or pointing device) to generate isOver events.

fields.name: touchTime
fields.doc: Time event generated when sensor is touched by pointing device, and then deselected by the user.

nodes.name: Transform
nodes.summary: Transform is a Grouping node that can contain most nodes.

fields.name: children
fields.doc: Grouping nodes contain an ordered list of children nodes.

fields.name: bboxCenter
fields.doc: Bounding box center accompanies bboxSize and provides an optional hint for bounding box position offset from origin of local coordinate system.

fields.name: bboxSize
fields.doc: Bounding box size is usually omitted, and can easily be calculated automatically by an X3D player at scene-loading time with minimal computational cost.

fields.name: bboxDisplay
fields.doc: Whether to display bounding box for associated geometry, aligned with world coordinates.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: Whether or not renderable content within this node is visually displayed.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Translation offset from origin of local coordinate system, applied prior to rotation or scaling.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Orientation (axis, angle in radians) of children relative to local coordinate system.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Non-uniform x-y-z scale of child coordinate system, adjusted by center and scaleOrientation.

fields.name: scaleOrientation
fields.doc: Preliminary rotation of coordinate system before scaling (to allow scaling around arbitrary orientations).

fields.name: translation
fields.doc: Position (x, y, z in meters) of children relative to local coordinate system.

nodes.name: Viewpoint
nodes.summary: Viewpoint provides a specific location and direction where the user may view the scene.

fields.name: set_bind
fields.doc: Sending event set_bind=true makes this node active.

fields.name: bindTime
fields.doc: Event sent reporting timestamp when node becomes active/inactive.

fields.name: isBound
fields.doc: Output event true gets sent when node becomes bound and activated, otherwise output event false gets sent when node becomes unbound and deactivated.

fields.name: fieldOfView
fields.doc: Preferred minimum viewing angle from this viewpoint in radians, providing minimum height or minimum width (whichever is smaller).

fields.name: jump
fields.doc: Transition instantly by jumping, otherwise smoothly adjust offsets in place when changing to this Viewpoint.

fields.name: retainUserOffsets
fields.doc: Retain (true) or reset to zero (false) any prior user navigation offsets from defined viewpoint position, orientation.

fields.name: viewAll
fields.doc: Viewpoint is automatically adjusted to view all visible geometry.

fields.name: orientation
fields.doc: Rotation (axis, angle in radians) of Viewpoint, relative to default -Z axis direction in local coordinate system.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: position (x, y, z in meters) relative to local coordinate system.

fields.name: centerOfRotation
fields.doc: centerOfRotation specifies center point about which to rotate user's eyepoint when in EXAMINE or LOOKAT mode.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Text description or navigation hint to describe the significance of this model Viewpoint.

fields.name: farDistance
fields.doc: farDistance defines maximum clipping plane distance allowed for object display.

fields.name: nearDistance
fields.doc: nearDistance defines minimum clipping plane distance necessary for object display.

nodes.name: VisibilitySensor
nodes.summary: VisibilitySensor detects when user can see a specific object or region as they navigate the world.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Translation offset from origin of local coordinate system.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: size of visibility box around center location, oriented within local transformation frame.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Enables/disables node operation.

fields.name: isActive
fields.doc: isActive true/false events are sent when triggering the sensor.

fields.name: enterTime
fields.doc: Time event generated when user's camera enters visibility region for sensor.

fields.name: exitTime
fields.doc: Time event generated when user's camera exits visibility region for sensor.

nodes.name: WorldInfo
nodes.summary: WorldInfo contains a title and simple persistent metadata information about an X3D scene. This node is strictly for documentation purposes and has no effect on the visual appearance or behaviour of the world.

fields.name: info
fields.doc: Additional information about this model.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: title of this world, placed in window title.
